description: FTIA INSPIRE Liikenneverkot -teematietoaineisto is a dataset listed in Paikkatietohakemisto, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by vayla.fi. FTIA INSPIRE Transport Networks Theme Dataset is a dataset depicting the Transport Networks covering the whole of Finland. It contains the following INSPIRE feature types: Road network, Rail network, Waterway network and Air transport network. Coverage: FI. The portal shows the English title as "FTIA INSPIRE Transport Networks Theme Dataset" (machine-translated by the portal). It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-paikkatietohakemisto.
